title: The Sun's corona at the eclipse of 2027
subtitle: 2 August 2027: predict the shape of the corona before the Moon reveals it
hook: On 2 August 2027 the Moon will cover the Sun along a path from Spain to Egypt, and for up to six minutes the corona will shine around it. Predict its shape before the day.
event_words: the Moon reveals it on the day
